title: Validation errors return 422, not the 400 the requirement text illustrates
evidence: src/error.rs:22 maps ApiError::Validation to StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY (422); REQUIREMENTS R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'. 400 is reserved for unreadable JSON (error.rs:82) and non-integer ids (handlers.rs:130).
suggestion: Defensible and documented in README; 422 is semantically correct for a syntactically-valid but invalid body. No change needed — noted for cross-run comparison since some runs use 400.

title: Optional fields validated beyond spec (year range, ISBN shape)
evidence: src/models.rs:52 rejects year outside -4000..2200; src/models.rs:112 is_plausible_isbn checks 10/13-char shape. Spec only required title+author.
suggestion: Beyond-spec strictness; documented in agent summary as 'most likely thing to want loosened'. Not a deduction.
